title: ReinforcementAxes
description: Six-axis reinforcement weighting model for memory nodes. v0.6.

default.name: duration
default.description: Time window over which the pattern recurs (longer = more weight)

default.name: recurrence
default.description: Distinct observations clustering into this node

default.name: surfaces
default.description: Distinct surfaces (machines, users, features) the pattern appears in

formula.description: Authoritative formula as of v0.6. Weights sum to 1.20 because operator_boost is additive on top of the base 1.00.

default: The base 1.00 underweights high-severity-low-recurrence patterns; the 0.20 operator_boost axis exists to compensate but is manually applied. v1.0 should refactor to remove the need for manual boost.
